description.value: Kung Pao Wok is a quick-service Chinese food franchise founded as a family company in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, now operating roughly 100 locations across North America in regional and super-regional shopping centres. The Richmond location sits on level 1 of a shopping centre at Shell Road, serving made-on-site Chinese food. The chain operates a mix of corporate and franchised outlets, with all menu items prepped and cooked fresh on-site.
